css.name: --ok-font-family
css.value: "Nunito Variable", "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

events.description: Before the drawer closes. Call `preventDefault()` to keep it open.
events.name: ok:drawer:beforeclose

events.description: Before the drawer opens. Call `preventDefault()` to keep it closed. A swipe from the edge (`data-ok-swipeable`) fires it with `trigger: null` once the finger lifts.
events.name: ok:drawer:beforeopen

events.description: After the drawer closed, with what closed it.
events.name: ok:drawer:close

methods.description: Closes the drawer. Returns `false` if `ok:drawer:beforeclose` was prevented or it is permanent. A temporary drawer slides out first: `ok:drawer:close` fires once it is closed.
methods.name: close

methods.description: Opens the drawer. Returns `false` if `ok:drawer:beforeopen` was prevented.
methods.name: open

methods.description: Opens the drawer when it is closed, and closes it otherwise.
methods.name: toggle

options.description: Edge the drawer is attached to.
options.name: anchor

options.description: `temporary`: modal `<dialog>`; `persistent`: docked `<aside>` that opens and closes; `permanent`: docked, always shown.
options.name: variant

options.description: Temporary only: Escape doesn't request close.
options.name: disableEscapeKeyDown

options.description: Temporary only: focus isn't moved back to the trigger on close.
options.name: disableRestoreFocus

options.description: Temporary only: the page behind can still scroll while it is open.
options.name: disableScrollLock

options.description: Shadow depth of the panel, `0`–`24` (`--ok-elevation-<n>`). Without it, each edge has its own shadow and docked drawers none.
options.name: elevation

options.description: Length of the slide in and out (ms). Default: the theme's short duration.
options.name: transitionDuration

options.description: Temporary only: a touch or pen swipe towards the edge closes the drawer, and one from the edge of the screen opens it. Keep a button that opens and closes it too.
options.name: swipeable

options.description: Swipeable: width of the strip along the edge of the screen where a swipe opens the drawer (px).
options.name: swipeAreaWidth

options.description: Swipeable: how far the panel must be pulled to open or close, as a share of its size (0 to 1).
options.name: hysteresis

options.description: Swipeable: speed from which a shorter swipe still opens or closes the drawer (px per second).
options.name: minFlingVelocity

options.description: Swipeable: no strip at the edge of the screen, so a swipe only closes the drawer.
options.name: disableSwipeToOpen

options.description: Swipeable: touching the edge strip doesn't slide a sliver of the panel in.
options.name: disableDiscovery

options.description: Swipeable: the backdrop doesn't fade with the panel while it is swiped (less work on slow devices).
options.name: disableBackdropTransition

parts.description: Closes the drawer whose `id` it names, or, without a value, the drawer it sits in.
parts.name: data-ok-drawer-close

parts.description: Opens the drawer whose `id` it names.
parts.name: data-ok-drawer-open

parts.description: Swipeable drawers: an empty `aria-hidden` strip right after the dialog, along the edge of the screen, where a touch swipe opens it. Shown on touch screens only.
parts.name: data-ok-drawer-swipe-area

parts.description: Swipeable drawers: the panel slides to rest after a swipe. Written by the script.
parts.name: data-ok-swipe-settling

parts.description: Swipeable drawers: the panel follows a finger. Written by the script.
parts.name: data-ok-swiping
